Simple and understated. A fluid A-line skirt with an elastic waistband and full
length. In our body-skimming jersey knit that dresses up or down.

Style No. S3TFF-S4267

Design


- An A-line silhouette that’s wider at the hem. Fits the body with ease.

- Select colors and sizes may vary by store.

- 5'9" model in Black is wearing a size extra small, which measures 34 1/2 inches on the body. Size petite small measures 32 1/2 inches on the body.

- 3-inch-wide yoke with 1/2-inch waistband.

- Back darts for shape.

- Style No. S3TFF-S4267
- SKU:196124719871

Fabric


- Our medium-weight jersey that effortlessly moves from day to night. Fluid and polished in sustainable Tencel™ Lyocell.

- Machine wash cold.

- Made in Vietnam. 92% Tencel™ Lyocell/8% Elastane.


Sustainability


- Tencel™ Lyocell fiber is made from responsibly harvested trees.

Thank you EF!!!!!!!!

beautiful skirtI first bought this skirt in Ocean (a dusty dark blue), and liked it so much I also bought it in black. Although I love and respect EILEEN FISHER clothing for the company's dedication to sustainability, my main problem with the clothing itself is that the styles seem to be getting more and more shapeless and baggy. But this skirt skims the body in an elegant, flattering way, without being clingy or tight. If they don't fade in the wash, I know I'll wear the skirts until they disintegrate. I've received some real compliments about my appearance (multiple "You look gorgeous!") while wearing the blue skirt with just plain white t-shirts and gold sandals, but both colors look great with just about everything. I wish the skirt was available in white, and in a different fabric, for variety. Maybe next summer??
